verdict.rationale: Vue documents its own building blocks for scaling: a performant, compiler-optimized rendering system, an ecosystem that scales up to a full framework with official Router and Pinia, provide/inject for deep dependency sharing, typed props inference, and an official testing guide. Large-codebase maintainability is only implied, and community users who built semi-large or complex apps report data-flow and 'magic' friction, though these are preferences rather than concrete failures. Missing for 10: first-party guidance or benchmarks showing sustained performance at large-app scale, documented team-scale maintainability practices (community notes there are no accepted best practices), and independent evidence of large codebases staying fast and maintainable over time.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build large applications that stay fast and maintainable as my team and codebase grow

citations.quote: Truly reactive, compiler-optimized rendering system that rarely requires manual optimization.
